summary: Tuned Boyer-Moore search panics with debug assertions enabled when the haystack is shorter than its literal pattern. The fix returns None for this valid no-match case. The added regression::literal_panic test checks that matching typename type\-parameter\-\d+\-\d+::.+ against "test" returns false. Both reversal regions occur exactly once, and replacing the fixed region restores the parent implementation file exactly. Tests were not run.
